sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
  COUNTIF(oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')) AS units_sold,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(oi.sale_price - p.cost), SUM(oi.sale_price)) * 100, 1) AS margin_pct
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.order_items` oi
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products` p ON p.id = oi.product_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  AND DATE(oi.created_at) BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
